profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Web Application Development in JavaScript, Angular, Bootstrap(Front End), and Java (Backend).
NodeJS

Desktop Application Development in C# .NET Framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Fully Translated and moved Corporate website (www.ogsystems.com) to Angular, NodeJS, and Microsoft Azure Cloud.
Developed a Contract Date Validation Tool.
Developed a Contract Filtering Tool using and refactoring design by translating HTML code to Ajax.
Redesigned Contract Building Page User Interface.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Designed a Gateway Language Database (GOLD) for Eastern African Languages
Developed a Web Application for visually learning languages stored in the GOLD Database.
Maintained a Web Application to learn Western European Romance Languages (WERL).
Unit Test writing for WERL Web Application

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Worked on a modeling customization  of ESRI Map using C# and Visual Studio.NET 2010 and 2013
Designed a method to project a 3D Map into a Cylindrical Projection
Developed an algorithm to convert British National Grid coordinates to Latitude/Longitude
Developed a filter of locations (coordinates) to be displayed on the map.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Refactored software to include more innovatively efficient features.
Translated the components code from Visual Basic 6.0 to C# in a .net framework
Tested the software for errors, bugs, and other anomalies to work in the new OS upgrade.
Redesigned the code to separate an Aerial Weapon Component into five separate variants.
Re-factored the code for a specific weapon variant to match the new business logic.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helped produce an application that exposed an API to the simulation program to monitor and store satellite coordinates into a MySQL database. 
Developed and integrated object-oriented java component into main simulation program to help access and manipulate database using JDBC. 
Upgraded the quality measurement program, in order to monitor all the current projects results and level of performance.
